title: Human–AI Interactions in Public Sector Decision Making: “Automation Bias” and “Selective Adherence” to Algorithmic Advice
reasoning: The paper is a social science study exploring human cognitive biases (automation bias and selective adherence) when interacting with algorithmic decision-support systems. While it touches on 'moral agency' and 'ethical disengagement' as psychological mechanisms, it is not an evaluation or benchmark of morals, ethics, or religion.
